\section{1. Purpose}




This module converts the gaps identified in the live job snapshot and application targeting protocol into a concrete closure plan.




The current job-market evidence shows that Alexander should not apply as a generic Unity candidate. The stronger path is:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Unity WebGL / Real-Time 3D Developer
Technical Visualization + Technical Art
XR / Simulation-adjacent portfolio
C# + shaders + optimization + 3D pipeline
\end{mdcode}




This means the application package must prove the following before serious application volume:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
1. Unity proof
2. C# proof
3. WebGL proof
4. technical visualization proof
5. CAD-to-realtime proof
6. technical-art / visual-mode proof
7. optimization proof
8. portfolio proof
9. GitHub proof
10. English professional communication proof
11. contractor/remote readiness proof
12. interview-defense readiness
\end{mdcode}

\section{6. CV gap closure}




\subsection{6.1 Current CV risk}




The market sample shows seniority pressure and portfolio expectations. A generic CV will underperform.




The CV must not say only:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Unity Developer
\end{mdcode}




It must say:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Real-Time 3D Developer / Unity Technical Artist
\end{mdcode}




or a role-specific variant.




\subsection{6.2 CV headline variants}




\begin{center}

\begin{longtable}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.455\linewidth} >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.455\linewidth}}

Unity WebGL / Interactive 3D Developer & WebGL roles \\

\bottomrule

\end{center}




\subsection{6.3 CV summary core}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Real-Time 3D Developer / Unity Technical Artist focused on Unity WebGL, C#, CAD-to-realtime optimization and interactive technical visualization. Built TwinSight X500, a browser-based drone assembly inspection prototype with component selection, exploded view, cross-section tools, visual modes, technical UI and SUS/NASA-TLX evaluation.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{6.4 TwinSight CV bullet set}




Use 3–5 bullets depending on role.




\subsubsection{Default bullets}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
- Built TwinSight X500, a Unity WebGL technical visualization prototype for drone assembly inspection using Unity, C#, URP, UI Toolkit and Blender.
- Implemented component selection, exploded view, cross-section/clipping tools, visual modes and technical information panels for interactive 3D inspection.
- Optimized CAD-derived source routes exceeding 6.5M triangles into a 95,617-triangle WebGL-ready model while preserving component-level readability.
- Evaluated the prototype with 12 participants using SUS, NASA-TLX Raw and Think-Aloud protocols, collecting 96 task-condition records.
- Documented technical constraints, usability findings and future improvements for digital-twin-adjacent technical visualization workflows.
\end{mdcode}




\subsubsection{Technical Artist variant}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
- Developed visual inspection modes including realistic, X-ray, ghosted, blueprint, wireframe, solid and thermal-style qualitative views.
- Focused on rendering constraints, WebGL performance, visual readability and technical-art presentation for interactive inspection.
\end{mdcode}




\subsubsection{Unity WebGL variant}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
- Deployed the prototype as a browser-based Unity WebGL viewer, emphasizing no-install access, runtime interaction and optimized 3D assets.
\end{mdcode}




\subsubsection{Technical Visualization variant}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
- Designed the viewer to reduce spatial reasoning friction in drone assembly understanding compared with static 2D support.
\end{mdcode}
